title: Sum of third moments
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $(\Omega,\Sigma)$ be a measurable space with measure $\mu$, and let $X_1,\ldots,X_n:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be measurable-space functions. The third-moment sum is $\sum_{i=1}^n\int_\Omega |X_i(\omega)|^3\,d\mu(\omega)$.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ is a family of $n$ real-valued functions on $\Omega$
